title: UI library components
description: components.gen.json: the UI library's public API in one file, written by scripts/gen/components.mjs from src/ui. Import everything from @/ui.

figmaFileUrl.description: The Rove Design System file's URL, copied from figma-components.json.

components.description: Every component, by its export name.

iconNames.description: Every icon component's export name, A to Z.

otherExports.description: Every other export (hooks, functions, constants), by name, with its doc comment.

libraryGroup.description: Its group in the library, from the comment above it in src/ui/index.ts.

sourceFile.description: The file that defines it, from the repo root.

description.description: Its doc comment: what it's for.

figmaComponent.description: Its entry in figma-components.json, or null when Figma has none.

oneOf.description: The component has no Figma counterpart.

props.description: Its own props, A to Z.

passesExtraPropsToElement.description: True when props it doesn't list (aria-*, a Tooltip's handlers) pass straight to the element it renders.

storyIds.description: Its stories' ids: open one at http://localhost:6006/?path=/story/<id> (npm run storybook).

typeScriptType.description: Its TypeScript type, when it isn't a set of values.

allowedValues.description: The values it takes, when it's a union of literals.

isRequired.description: True when it must be passed.

guidance.description: When to use it, when not, and accessibility, from its stories' guidance parameter, as its Docs page shows them.

whenNotToUse.description: Cases it doesn't suit, each naming what to use instead.

builtIn.description: What it already does for assistive tech.

toHandle.description: What the code using it must still do.
